annotations.title: Choose what crosses from a folder

description: CHOOSE WHAT CROSSES from a folder, per kind of detail the last nodata_scan_folder found (ID numbers, names, emails, bank details, secrets, the user's own terms, files not read): each kind crosses or is withheld. A part of the folder holding a withheld kind goes out only as a clean copy, or stays closed when very sensitive; the rest goes as the folder is. The same choice as the site's "Choose what crosses" panel. Without changes it shows the panel ("May cross · N of M"): show it to the user as it is and let THEM choose. cross / withhold change kinds (by name, as shown); all:'cross' selects all, all:'withhold' withholds all. approve:true makes it policy: this computer's owner approves it in the browser (opened for them), then it is recorded in a signed receipt and applied as rules on the rules board. You only propose: never approve for the user, and call approve only when the user asked for it. Counts and kinds only, never a value. An approved policy puts the folder on AUTOPILOT: the read gate answers by the policy instead of asking on each file (a kind it never saw still asks). autopilot:false takes the folder off it. coverage:true answers "is everything covered, and is there anything new to enforce?" for every project and scanned folder on this computer: new projects not scanned yet, folders without a policy, files changed since the scan, kinds the policy never saw, and the one next step for each. Use it when the user starts a new project, adds a folder or files, or asks whether they are protected.

approval_id.description: An approval already asked for (from a WAITING answer).

approve.description: true = ask this computer's owner to approve the choice as policy, in the browser. Only when the user asked.

autopilot.description: With approve: false approves without autopilot (default on). Alone: false takes the folder off autopilot.

coverage.description: true = the coverage report for every project and scanned folder on this computer.

cross.description: Kinds that may cross (names as the panel shows them).

path.description: The folder, as scanned with nodata_scan_folder. Not needed with coverage:true.
